additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
a Client tried to charge today 24th of February, between 13:00 and 13:20 (CU time) on charger 3314176150001.
After several pre-authorization, the car didn't get any energy from the charger and all charges went to 0.
The Client informed us that on his car dashboard there was this error : "Charging system: fault! Only DC charging possible. Contact the workshop".
Could you please do a log check and let us know if an error occurred?
Thanks in advance,
regards.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480325-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/T3 314176150001] log check CRM:02889001170
additional_info.body:
Dear Mrs. Pace,
I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for raising the issue. I have checked the specified time you provided.
I saw DC1 is charging well in DC2 on 13:00 the EV didn´t communicate with the charger.
Even though this car could charge in DC1 a couple of mins later, our logs indicate a fault in the locking mechanism of the EV. As such, for safety, the charger doesn't continue the session
During the timestamp you provided, there seems to be no AC charging sessions, also, from that message you report to us, it's possible that the EV doesn't allow AC charging, or at least has a fault that cannot charge with AC until it gets checked in the workshop.
Let me know, if you have further question. Otherwise a quick feedback will help us to close the ticket.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
